- The registration link must be prominently displayed in the menu and accessible within 2 clicks.
- The link should be labeled with clear text such as "Register for Camp" to enhance visibility.
- The registration form must load within 3 seconds after clicking the link to ensure a smooth user experience.

Test Outline:
- Navigate through the menu to confirm that the registration link is easily found and accessible within the specified number of clicks.
- Check the link's label to ensure it clearly indicates its purpose for registration.
- Measure the loading time of the registration form after clicking the link to verify it meets the performance criteria.

Original User Story: As a anonymoususer, I want to fill out a user registration form, so that I can register for the camp and get an account on the website.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a anonymoususer, I want to complete a user registration form so that I can successfully create an account on the website and secure my spot for the camp.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The registration form must include fields for at least name, email, and password, with all fields validated for correctness.
- Users should receive a confirmation email within 3 minutes of submitting the registration form.
- The account must be accessible immediately after registration, allowing users to log in without additional steps.

Test Outline:
- Verify that all required fields are present and validate the input for correctness upon submission.
- Check the user's email inbox to confirm receipt of the registration confirmation email within the specified time frame.
- Attempt to log in with the newly created account to ensure immediate access is granted.

Original User Story: As a anonymoususer, I want to find session information, so that I can go to a session.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a anonymoususer, I want to access session information quickly so that I can easily navigate to the desired session without unnecessary delays.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Provide a search functionality that allows users to find session information within 3 clicks.
- Ensure that session details are displayed within 2 seconds of the search request.
- Include clear navigation links to the session page for at least 90% of the displayed sessions.

Test Outline:
- Test the search functionality to confirm that session information can be accessed within the specified number of clicks.
- Measure the time taken to display session details after a search request to ensure it meets the 2-second requirement.
- Verify that navigation links are present and functional for the majority of displayed sessions.
